paper_title: Towards an electrostatic storage ring for fundamental physics measurements
notes: Conference proceeding describing a proposed electrostatic storage ring. Projected (not measured) sensitivities shown in Fig. 4 for axion-electron coupling (left panel, demonstrator) and axion-nucleon coupling (right panel, final stage with polarized Xe), covering mass range 1e-19 to 1e-9 eV. Also mentions dark photon DM. Pre-analysis hint of AxionEDM is misleading: the EDM part is a separate use case, while the DM projections are on axion-electron and axion-nucleon spin couplings. No numerical tables provided; the exclusion curves are only in a figure with unreadable axis tick placement, so no reliable data points could be extracted. Coupling type ambiguous between AxionElectron and AxionNeutron (two panels). | [VISION GATE A] is_projection=true but the vision notes say the traced curve is existing EXCLUSION — not the paper's own projected curve ; [VISION GATE D] vision notes admit tracing a compilation envelope ('ENVELOPE of the existing EXCLUSION curves') rather than the paper's own single curve
